title: Taking the Annual Medical Deductible Out of a Restated Ridgecrest Advantage Claim Line
content:
On a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan, the annual medical deductible still unmet is the annual medical deductible of the plan held less the plan allowed amount of the in-network claim lines already adjudicated on the enrollment, and is never less than nothing. How much of it is taken out of the line a correction restates follows the network standing of that line and the size of the deductible still unmet against the plan allowed amount of the line.

1. Where the line the correction restates is an out-of-network line, no part of the annual medical deductible is taken out of it.
2. Where the line the correction restates is an in-network line and the annual medical deductible still unmet is more than the plan allowed amount of that line, the whole plan allowed amount of the line is taken for the deductible.
3. Where the line the correction restates is an in-network line and the annual medical deductible still unmet is no more than the plan allowed amount of that line, the annual medical deductible still unmet is taken out of it.

An in-network line on which the deductible still unmet exactly equals the plan allowed amount of the line falls under the third entry, because the deductible still unmet is then no more than that plan allowed amount; the whole of the line is taken for the deductible either way.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

*An in-network line whose plan allowed amount is 500.00 USD, on an enrollment where the annual medical deductible of the plan held is 495.00 USD and the in-network claim lines already adjudicated carry 95.00 USD in all.* The deductible still unmet is 400.00 USD, which is no more than 500.00 USD, so 400.00 USD is taken out of the line.

*The same enrollment, with an in-network line whose plan allowed amount is 250.00 USD.* The deductible still unmet of 400.00 USD is more than 250.00 USD, so the whole plan allowed amount of 250.00 USD is taken for the deductible.

*An out-of-network line whose plan allowed amount is 500.00 USD on the same enrollment.* No part of the annual medical deductible is taken out of it.
